_comment: Committed list of paper_trades docs known to be fake trades from an in-bar futures contract-roll splice, not real strategy behaviour. api/paper.py's nightly upsert (api/paper._run_one_uid._emit) checks every trade it writes against this list by (leg, entry_unix) and adds roll_artifact=true / roll_note on a match. The trade is KEPT (never deleted) -- see ROLL_AUDIT.md section 'Urgent (live/paper)' item 1 and section 4.5.4/4.5.5 for the full investigation. Matched and verified against live Firestore docs on 2026-09-26 (all 17 entries: exact leg + entry_unix + recorded_pnl_usd match to the cent); see tools/mark_roll_artifacts.py for the one-off script that applied the flags. Do not remove entries here without owner sign-off -- api/paper.py's re-upsert re-applies these fields every night as long as they stay in this file.
